description: Create an owned agent email address. Requires a Free account: one random inbox lasting activeDays (1–7, default 3). Pro allows 10 and Team 50 inboxes that remain active while subscribed; localPart selects a custom address on paid plans. Retired addresses are never reused. Then call wait_for_email.

activeDays.description: Free inbox lifetime in days; defaults to 3.

localPart.description: Optional custom name, 3–48 lowercase letters, numbers or single hyphens. Pro or Team only.

name: create_email_inbox
